user.title: EV Charge Optimizer
user.description: Connect to AgilePredict ({api_url}) to get 14-day Octopus Agile price forecasts and receive intelligent EV charging recommendations.

data_description.target_charge_pct: The charge level to aim for (e.g. 80% for battery longevity)

data_description.expensive_percentile: Prices above this percentile are considered 'expensive'
